releaseNotes: Reworked verse study into a floating, selected-verse overlay so study resources no longer push Scripture out of place. Added direct access to prayer, declarations, dictionary, commentary and theology, original-language study, cross-references, notes and the full Study Centre inside the overlay. Routed the YouVersion comparison panel into the same selected-verse experience. The offline KJV remains the dependable base; online translations remain optional until the secure YouVersion Worker is deployed and authorised versions are verified.
